entries.subject: A sampled Gaia spectrum for the colour lens
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 releases externally calibrated sampled spectra only for the brighter sources; TRAPPIST-1 at G = 15.62 carries only the continuous basis-function coefficients (has_xp_sampled false, has_xp_continuous true). The coefficients are pinned and sampled here with GaiaXPy onto the archive's own grid, which is the same calibration the sampled product uses.

entries.subject: Imagery of the photosphere
entries.finding: No image of this star's disc exists or is expected: at 12.47 pc it is about 0.09 milliarcseconds across, far below any interferometer's reach. The colour lens is its own measured spectrum.
entries.revisitWhen: A resolved image of TRAPPIST-1's disc in a public archive.

entries.subject: JWST measurements of the planets
entries.finding: The ten MIRI/F1500W visits of Gillon, Ducrot et al. (2025)'s joint fit are reduced from raw here: program 3077's 59-hour phase curve (both exposures, 108 segments), five eclipses of b (program 1177, observations 7-11) and four of c (program 2304, observations 1-4). They give TRAPPIST-1b's temperature map and TRAPPIST-1c's measured dayside (see those packages). Program 1279 and the remaining archive observations are not used.

entries.subject: Planet sizes and transit times at 15 um from the joint fit
entries.finding: The joint least-squares fit also measures the transits in the phase curve: radius ratios 0.0824 (b), 0.0839 (c) and 0.0875 (g), against Agol et al. (2021)'s 0.08590 and 0.08440 that seed b and c; g was seeded, by a slip, with b's 0.08590 instead of its own 0.08692, inside a prior 0.01 wide, ten times the difference, and transit times 60271.25436 (b), 60273.23314 (c) and 60271.47930 (g) BMJD. They are not used for the packages' facts: the least-squares fit gives no uncertainties, and the 6,000-step MCMC of the same model did not converge (123 free parameters, acceptance 0.12).
entries.revisitWhen: A converged posterior of the joint fit, giving the radii and transit times their uncertainties.
